caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with four legs, a contoured seat, and a decorative backrest. The chair is predominantly brown with lighter accents highlighting the edges and contours, possibly representing wood grain or painted trim. The backrest is curved and features an ornamental cutout design in the center. The front legs of the chair are turned with a spindle shape, while the back legs are straight and slightly splayed. There are horizontal support bars connecting the legs for added stability. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with some light brown shading beneath and behind the chair, suggesting shadow and depth. There are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Chair (painted)
